items.title: Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) did not practice Wednesday.
items.text: Darrisaw seemingly re-injured his shoulder in the Vikings’ Week 11 loss to the 49ers. Minnesota just held a walk-through, but the franchise left tackle starts out not practicing. He is truly questionable ahead of Week 12 against the Falcons. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) did not practice Wednesday.
items.text: Addison has yet to practice since undergoing thumb surgery last week. Vikings head coach Kevin O’Connell said Monday that the 24-year-old may not “necessarily” be back in Week 12 against the Falcons. Tai Felton will continue to get increased reps with Addison out. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Rachaad White (heel) is practicing in full for Week 12 against the Cardinals.
items.text: White dealt with this issue last week, but managed to be active on Monday night. He should be fine for backup duties in Week 1 2 against the Cardinals, though Jacory Croskey-Merritt is likely the only fantasy starter in this backfield. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) was limited on Wednesday.
items.text: Burks continues to play through his foot injury, albeit mostly ineffectively. He is a boom-bust downfield wide receiver who faces a tremendously soft Cardinals pass defense this week. Burks does not need to be in 12-team lineups. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jayden Daniels (left elbow/left hand) is practicing in full for Week 12 against the Cardinals.
items.text: Daniels’ left elbow issue is obviously not new, but the left hand injury is. That said, he is practicing in full and gets an exceptionally soft matchup against the Cardinals’ defense this week. Daniels is a high-end QB1, as usual. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Denzel Boston (quad) did not practice on Wednesday.
items.text: Boston continues to rack up lower-body injuries, though he tends to play through them. He dealt with a toe injury last week, catching just one pass for 16 yards. His practice participation is worth tracking closely this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Harold Fannin (groin) was limited on Wednesday.
items.text: Fannin has been dealing with this groin injury since Week 9, but it has not impacted his productivity. Fannin is a locked-in TE1 against the Raiders in Week 12. Ideally, he will upgrade to full participation by the end of the week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Michael Mayer (back) is practicing in full for Week 12 against the Browns.
items.text: Mayer injured his back in the Raiders’ Week 11 loss to the Broncos, but he is evidently good to go this week. Brock Bowers (ankle) was limited today, tentatively putting him on track to face the Browns this weekend. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Brock Bowers (ankle) was limited on Wednesday.
items.text: Bowers closed last week with two limited sessions, listed with ankle and quad injuries. Fortunately, the quad injury is no longer an issue. He is tentatively on track to play in Week 12 against the Browns. Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said he is optimistic that Bowers will play this weekend, adding that having a bye in Week 13 will not factor into whether Bowers suits up this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jahan Dotson (hamstring) did not practice on Wednesday.
items.text: Dotson and Zachariah Branch (hamstring) both missed Wednesday’s practice. Dotson is not relevant in 12-team leagues, and Branch has earned just 12 targets this season. Neither player is consequential. - Nic Bodiford
